status: post-label implementation correction; exploratory until held-out confirmation
frozen_policy_text: Select retrieval only when the retrieval-isolated assessments give specific factual reasons that the memory verdict is wrong and converge on the retrieval verdict. The memory endpoint is the fallback under insufficient or internally conflicting analysis.
missing_validator_diagnosis: The v1 parser validated the selector JSON shape but did not enforce the frozen semantic policy. Twenty of 28 attacked retrieval requests lacked either two-check convergence on the retrieval label or direct factual support in both checks.

semantic_guard.accept_retrieval_if: selector requests retrieval AND both check verdicts equal the retrieval endpoint label AND both knowledge_basis fields are direct_recall AND both decisive_propositions lists are nonempty

interpretation.required_next_step: Freeze this exact guard and evaluate once on untouched held-out claims without further prompt, threshold, or policy tuning.
